acceptanceCriteria: The Beamfall task above, rerun on the same BASE, either returns the trust-root files as authoritative results or the abstention names the stage that dropped them (V1-0122 accounting).
A frozen evaluation or regression fixture records the case, and the relevance floor is not lowered for Corvint's own corpus without re-running the frozen query gates.
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the first complete Beamfall daily-path run (Beamfall scratch clone, change LCRES-15, BASE 0d7796be23efe4e2579408a5516b8aeff1a23008, bind 86fde0eb21d2e0fc41bfc06a4c06c9c3aef63e59; evidence retained in the session scratchpad beamfall-evidence/). `corvint query --task "Validate plugin trust roots at model loader construction..." --limit 1` returned context.abstention {active:true, reason:below-relevance-floor}, included_results 0, and withheld 13 test-path symbol candidates. Path impact on the same change found internal/plugin/trust.go and internal/integrationhost/model_loader.go with their tests, so the evidence exists in the index. The equivalent Corvint self-dogfood query returned one authoritative result. Because UC-TASK-ORIENTATION needs a PASS beamfall-dogfood receipt (V1-0184, V1-0011), this abstention blocks the orientation row on the only external adopter. Abstention itself is correct behaviour under invariant 2; the question is why the floor rejects the obvious files.
title: query: a precise Beamfall task abstains `below-relevance-floor` with zero results, so the Beamfall orientation receipt cannot PASS
